# Full Rewind current standard weekend product

Reduced from the public read-only Shopify Ajax product endpoint `https://full-rewind.de/products/full-rewind-weekend-ticket-2027.js`, checked 2026-11-17 23:38 UTC (HTTP 200, text/javascript, JSON body). Discovered through the official current collection `https://full-rewind.de/collections/tickets-2027/products.json?limit=250`.

Kept only the product/variant identity, first description paragraph containing admission dates, booleans, price and quantity rule required by the adapter. No credentials, contact copy, tracking, cart/order operations, or whole-page capture. Product and variant availability were both true. Other current products in the collection were parking-only and are deliberately not admission inventory.

A false availability flag establishes `unavailable`, not a proven whole-festival `sold_out`; changed product schemas, variants or dates require review. Fixtures demonstrate structure, not production freshness. Existing official homepage/bands evidence and artist review gates remain mandatory.
